note.note:
I’m unable to generate the Problem List Clinical Note because the required content is missing. The transcript and DDx blocks appear as placeholders ("{transcript}" and "{ddx}"), and I need the actual text to proceed.

Please provide:
- The full clinical transcript (doctor-patient dialogue)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) as JSON

Once provided, I will produce the structured note exactly as requested:
- Consult Summary (two-line)
- Problem List with up to three issues, each including timeline, symptoms, exam findings, social history, meds, differential diagnoses (from DDx) with Likelihood (High/Moderate/Low) and one-line justification
- Medications (with dosages if given; otherwise note “dose/route/frequency not documented”)
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks (including conflict notes if transcript and DDx conflict)

If helpful, I can also provide a ready-to-fill template or confirm how I will format each section after you share the content.
